title: 3D Printer Generated Tissue iMolds for Cleared Tissue Evaluation
author: Miller, Rothstein

steps.title: Create 3D tissue mold
steps.instruction: Capture images of the specimen, import the images into design software, design a structural mold that fits precisely around the specimen, and print the mold using a 3D printer with affordable plastic.

substeps.instruction: Import images into CAD software and design a structural mold that fits the specimen.
Print the designed mold on a 3D printer using affordable plastic.

steps.title: Deep tissue staining
steps.instruction: Incubate the specimen with primary antibody for 5 days, then with secondary antibody for 3 days, following the previously established protocol.

substeps.instruction: Incubate specimen with primary antibody for 5 days.
Incubate specimen with secondary antibody for 3 days.
